quote: "The designated representatives of the Member States shall adopt the Board’s rules of procedure by a two-thirds majority"
legal_practice_note: Governance procedure row with indirect relevance to legal practice.

summary: The Board must establish two standing subgroups for cooperation and exchange among market surveillance authorities and notifying authorities on market-surveillance and notified-body issues.
quote: "The Board shall establish two standing sub-groups to provide a platform for cooperation and exchange among market surveillance authorities and notifying authorities"
legal_practice_note: Governance row with indirect relevance to notified-body and enforcement consistency.

summary: The Board must be organised and operated to safeguard the objectivity and impartiality of its activities.
quote: "The Board shall be organised and operated so as to safeguard the objectivity and impartiality of its activities"
legal_practice_note: Governance integrity row with indirect legal-practice relevance.

summary: The Board is chaired by a Member State representative; the AI Office must provide the secretariat, convene meetings on the Chair’s request, and prepare the agenda under the Board’s tasks and rules.
quote: "The AI Office shall provide the secretariat for the Board, convene the meetings upon request of the Chair, and prepare the agenda"
legal_practice_note: Governance support row with indirect relevance to legal practice.

summary: The Board may coordinate national competent authorities and, with agreement of the market surveillance authorities concerned, support joint market-surveillance activities under Article 74(11).
quote: "contribute to the coordination among national competent authorities responsible for the application of this Regulation"
legal_practice_note: Governance task affecting enforcement consistency for legal-AI providers and deployers.

summary: The Board may collect and share technical and regulatory expertise and best practices among Member States.
quote: "collect and share technical and regulatory expertise and best practices among Member States"
legal_practice_note: Governance knowledge-sharing with indirect relevance to legal practice.

summary: The Board may advise on AI Act implementation, particularly enforcement of rules on general-purpose AI models.
quote: "provide advice on the implementation of this Regulation, in particular as regards the enforcement of rules on general-purpose AI models"
legal_practice_note: Indirect relevance for legal-AI vendors that use or provide GPAI models.

summary: The Board may help harmonise Member State administrative practices, including for conformity-assessment derogations, AI regulatory sandboxes, and real-world testing.
quote: "contribute to the harmonisation of administrative practices in the Member States"
legal_practice_note: Indirect relevance to legal-AI providers using conformity routes, sandboxes, or real-world testing.

summary: At the Commission’s request or on its own initiative, the Board may issue recommendations and written opinions on AI Act implementation and consistent, effective application across listed matters.
quote: "issue recommendations and written opinions on any relevant matters related to the implementation of this Regulation and to its consistent and effective application"
legal_practice_note: Governance recommendations may influence legal-AI compliance expectations.

summary: The Board may support the Commission in promoting AI literacy, public awareness and understanding of AI benefits, risks, safeguards, rights and obligations.
quote: "support the Commission in promoting AI literacy, public awareness and understanding of the benefits, risks, safeguards and rights and obligations in relation to the use of AI systems"
legal_practice_note: AI-literacy governance indirectly supports legal AI users and deployers.

summary: The Board may facilitate common criteria and shared understanding among market operators and authorities of AI Act concepts, including by contributing to benchmark development.
quote: "facilitate the development of common criteria and a shared understanding among market operators and competent authorities of the relevant concepts provided for in this Regulation"
legal_practice_note: Shared concepts can affect legal-AI classification and compliance interpretation.

summary: The Board may cooperate with Union institutions, bodies, offices, agencies, expert groups and networks across product safety, cybersecurity, competition, digital and media services, finance, consumer protection, data and fundamental rights.
quote: "cooperate, as appropriate, with other Union institutions, bodies, offices and agencies, as well as relevant Union expert groups and networks"
legal_practice_note: Cross-regulatory cooperation indirectly affects legal-AI systems intersecting with data, cybersecurity or consumer rules.

summary: The Board may contribute to effective cooperation with third-country competent authorities and international organisations.
quote: "contribute to effective cooperation with the competent authorities of third countries and with international organisations"
legal_practice_note: International cooperation indirectly affects cross-border legal-AI providers.

summary: The Board may assist national competent authorities and the Commission in developing organisational and technical expertise for AI Act implementation, including staff training-needs assessment.
quote: "assist national competent authorities and the Commission in developing the organisational and technical expertise required for the implementation of this Regulation"
legal_practice_note: Authority capacity-building indirectly affects enforcement experienced by legal-AI providers and deployers.

summary: The Board may assist the AI Office in supporting national competent authorities with AI regulatory sandboxes and may facilitate cooperation and information-sharing among sandboxes.
quote: "assist the AI Office in supporting national competent authorities in the establishment and development of AI regulatory sandboxes"
legal_practice_note: Sandbox support may indirectly benefit legal-AI innovators.

summary: The Board may contribute to and provide relevant advice on developing guidance documents.
quote: "contribute to, and provide relevant advice on, the development of guidance documents"
legal_practice_note: Guidance documents can affect legal-AI compliance interpretation.

summary: The Board may advise the Commission on international AI matters.
quote: "advise the Commission in relation to international matters on AI"
legal_practice_note: International AI policy advice has indirect relevance to cross-border legal AI.

summary: The Board may provide opinions to the Commission on qualified alerts concerning general-purpose AI models.
quote: "provide opinions to the Commission on the qualified alerts regarding general-purpose AI models"
legal_practice_note: Indirectly relevant to legal-AI products based on GPAI models that may be subject to qualified alerts.

summary: The Board may receive Member State opinions on qualified alerts about general-purpose AI models and on national monitoring and enforcement experience, including systems integrating GPAI models.
quote: "receive opinions by the Member States on qualified alerts regarding general-purpose AI models, and on national experiences and practices on the monitoring and enforcement of AI systems"
legal_practice_note: Indirect relevance to legal-AI systems integrating GPAI models.

summary: The Commission must adopt an implementing act establishing a scientific panel of independent experts to support enforcement activities under the AI Act.
quote: "The Commission shall, by means of an implementing act, make provisions on the establishment of a scientific panel of independent experts"
legal_practice_note: Governance enforcement-support row with indirect relevance to legal-AI providers.

summary: The scientific panel must consist of experts selected by the Commission for current AI scientific or technical expertise and ability to demonstrate expertise, independence from AI-system or GPAI-model providers, and diligent, accurate, objective work.
quote: "The scientific panel shall consist of experts selected by the Commission on the basis of up-to-date scientific or technical expertise in the field of AI"
legal_practice_note: Panel-selection governance with indirect relevance to legal-AI enforcement.

summary: The scientific panel must advise and support the AI Office on GPAI-model and system implementation and enforcement, including alerts, evaluation tools, systemic-risk classification advice, broader GPAI classification advice, and tools and templates.
quote: "The scientific panel shall advise and support the AI Office, in particular with regard to the following tasks:"
legal_practice_note: Indirectly relevant to legal-AI providers using GPAI models subject to AI Office enforcement.

summary: The scientific panel must support market surveillance authorities at their request.
quote: "supporting the work of market surveillance authorities, at their request"
legal_practice_note: Enforcement-support role that may indirectly affect legal-AI providers under market surveillance.

summary: The scientific panel must support cross-border market surveillance activities under Article 74(11), without prejudice to market surveillance authority powers.
quote: "supporting cross-border market surveillance activities as referred to in Article 74(11), without prejudice to the powers of market surveillance authorities"
legal_practice_note: Cross-border enforcement support may indirectly affect legal-AI providers operating in multiple Member States.

summary: The scientific panel must support the AI Office in carrying out duties under the Union safeguard procedure in Article 81.
quote: "supporting the AI Office in carrying out its duties in the context of the Union safeguard procedure pursuant to Article 81"
legal_practice_note: Union safeguard support indirectly affects legal-AI systems subject to EU-level measures.

summary: Scientific-panel experts must act impartially and objectively, keep information confidential, avoid seeking or taking instructions, publish declarations of interests, and the AI Office must manage and prevent conflicts of interest.
quote: "The experts on the scientific panel shall perform their tasks with impartiality and objectivity, and shall ensure the confidentiality of information and data obtained"
legal_practice_note: Governance integrity row with indirect relevance to legal-AI enforcement.

summary: The Commission implementing act establishing the scientific panel must include conditions, procedures and detailed arrangements for panel members to issue alerts and request AI Office assistance.
quote: "The implementing act referred to in paragraph 1 shall include provisions on the conditions, procedures and detailed arrangements for the scientific panel and its members to issue alerts"
legal_practice_note: Procedural governance for scientific-panel enforcement support with indirect legal-practice relevance.

summary: Member States may call upon scientific-panel experts to support their AI Act enforcement activities.
quote: "Member States may call upon experts of the scientific panel to support their enforcement activities under this Regulation"
legal_practice_note: Enforcement-support mechanism with indirect relevance to legal-AI providers and deployers.

summary: Member States may be required to pay fees for expert advice and support at a rate equivalent to Commission remuneration fees under the Article 68(1) implementing act.
quote: "The Member States may be required to pay fees for the advice and support provided by the experts at a rate equivalent to the remuneration fees applicable to the Commission"
legal_practice_note: Administrative funding row with indirect relevance to legal practice.

summary: The Commission must facilitate Member States’ timely access to scientific-panel experts and organise expert support and Union AI testing support efficiently for best added value.
quote: "The Commission shall facilitate timely access to the experts by the Member States, as needed"
legal_practice_note: Governance coordination row with indirect relevance to legal-AI enforcement.
